assessment: The manuscript describes the effects of dietary yeast and sugars on male Bactrocera dorsalis sex pheromone biosynthesis and other mating-related traits. This is an important study showing that yeast feeding stimulates the production of specific sex pheromones and promotes fly mating ability. The data are solid and will be of interest to the fields of chemical ecology and pest management.
